To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fuel consumption can be decreased by approximately 5% with the use of an engine with a high specific power and a low specific fuel consumption, and that a high engine efficiency is important to decrease the fuel consumption, and a high transmission efficiency is important to reduce the energy losses in the transmission.

a hybrid powertrain with a parallel configuration, a 1-speed transmission, a 48 V system and an electric motor that is able to operate in both generator and motoring mode, can achieve a fuel saving of 15% compared to a conventional powertrain.
the fuel consumption in a hybrid powertrain with a fixed engine torque and a fixed engine speed is optimized by a combination of engine torque, engine speed and battery state of charge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimization of a powertrain for fuel consumption.
developing a hybrid powertrain that is able to reduce fuel consumption and CO2 emissions in real world driving conditions.

the development of a new method for optimization of a hybrid powertrain with respect to the fuel consumption, and with the development of an efficient simulation tool that can be used for this purpose.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the optimization of the powertrain system is an extremely complex task and that there are many different factors that influence the fuel consumption and emissions.
the optimization of a parallel hybrid powertrain is not as simple as one would think.
the hybridization of a conventional powertrain with a hybrid powertrain has the potential to increase the fuel consumption of the vehicle by up to 20%.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a model for fuel consumption in a parallel hybrid vehicle.
we have shown that it is possible to optimize the fuel consumption in hybrid vehicles by taking the engine and the transmission into account.
we have been able to increase the fuel efficiency by 8 % in the hybrid powertrain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the fuel efficiency of a hybrid vehicle can be improved by optimizing the engine control strategy.
the hybridization is not always the best way to improve the fuel economy.
we can use the hybrid powertrain to reduce the fuel consumption and the emissions of the vehicle.
